description: NaH₃(SeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.51 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.22 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.05 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.05 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.79 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.82 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom.
